name: YouTube
description: Play YouTube videos, a playlist or a live stream (privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie embed).

schema.name: videos
schema.label: Videos
schema.help: One per line: a YouTube link or 11-character video id, optionally followed by a start and end time (seconds or m:ss), for example "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ 0:30 1:45". At most 50. With several videos, start and end apply to the first video only.

schema.name: playlist
schema.label: Playlist
schema.help: A playlist link (it contains list=...) or the playlist id.

schema.name: live
schema.label: Live stream
schema.help: The live video's link or id. A channel id (UC...) plays that channel's current live stream, but YouTube does not always honour this; a video link is more reliable.

schema.name: shuffle
schema.label: Shuffle
schema.help: Play the videos in a random order each time the slide starts.

schema.name: play_to_end
schema.label: End the slide when the video ends
schema.help: The slide's duration is then the longest it may run. When off, the video loops for the whole duration. Live streams always run for the full duration.

schema.name: mute
schema.label: Mute
schema.help: Sound plays in the AiSignX Windows and Android apps. A plain web browser only autoplays muted videos.

schema.name: captions
schema.label: Show captions
schema.help: When the video has captions. The plugin locale (Plugins > Settings) picks the language when it is available.

terms: Videos are embedded from youtube-nocookie.com and may show ads. Videos whose owners turned off embedding are skipped. Showing videos in public or in a business is subject to YouTube's Terms of Service and the rights of the video owners; that is the operator's responsibility.
